Led by coach [[Kyle Neptune]] in his second season as a head coach, the Wildcats played their home games at the [[Finneran Pavilion]] on the school's campus in the [[Philadelphia]] suburb of [[Villanova, Pennsylvania]] and [[Wells Fargo Center (Philadelphia)|Wells Fargo Center]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 17–17, 10–10 in Big East play, to tie for sixth place. They defeated [[2022–23 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] in the opening round of the [[2023 Big East men's basketball tournament|2023 Big East tournament]] before losing to [[2022–23 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]] in the quarterfinals. The Wildcats received an at-large bid to the [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]], losing in the first round to [[2022–23 Liberty Flames basketball team|Liberty]].
